notation_updates.description: Lead-adopted notation changes for this exact account under project_notation_v1. The harness generates the complete lookup from the frozen incoming view and these additions; do not author a second glossary. Historical records may omit this field.

method_formulation_markdown.description: Fuller source-backed mathematical account of the exact implemented method from the frozen Phase 2 definition and inspected implementation: inputs, model relationships, fitting criterion or estimating rule, target/output and decisive conditions. Follow the supplied scientific-explanation reference. Define notation in context and use proper Markdown/LaTeX; the authored method_recap_markdown supplies the visible short recap. Do not invent mathematics or infer it from outcomes. No numerical display belongs here.

implementation_markdown.description: Briefly state what code was developed, revised or reused and what was actually tested on synthetic and supplied actual data, naming absence or unperformed work honestly. Cite the implementation and result sources. Keep the detailed scientific account, numerical tables and figures in their existing records and Experiments and Results.

method_fidelity_markdown.description: Short account for Implementation and Code: checked correspondence to the exact frozen Phase 2 method, consequential implementation choices, unresolved departures and verification gaps. Cite the analyst account and independent audit rather than repeating their full technical explanations. A completed run does not prove fidelity. Keep quantitative tables and figures in Experiments and Results.

explanation_markdown.description: Distinguish no applicable Phase 3 theory, available theory not tested, and empirical tests of named claims. Numerical agreement is not proof; identify contradictions and limitations.

conclusion_markdown.description: Start with the decisive supported observation and its boundary for the stated researcher goal, including applicable uncertainty and tested scope. Follow the supplied summary and claims-and-evidence references. Preserve unsuccessful fits, inconclusive comparisons and synthetic/actual-data limits; absence of demonstrated benefit or nonsignificance does not establish no benefit or equivalence. Execution success is not scientific support. Keep the primary conclusion here and link detail rather than repeating every result.

tradeoff_markdown.description: Explain benefits and costs relevant to the researcher, distinguishing method runtime or memory from total evaluation budget. Preserve computational burden and uncertainty; a synthetic gain does not establish human benefit.

limitations_markdown.description: State consequential missing coverage, uncertain results, departures and attributed disagreement that limit the overall account.

recommendation_markdown.description: Recommend the next research or use decision with its evidence and resolving question, preserving researcher authorization.

coverage.description: One primary topical account composed from Analyst answers and verified exhibits, following the supplied summary reference. Use synthetic_example, performance, computation, tuning, robustness and actual_data when supplied, with assessed/partial evidence or an explicit not_assessed/not_applicable reason. Preserve scientific substance and do not require extra experiments to fill a topic.

dimension.description: Canonical topic for new accounts: synthetic_example, performance, computation, tuning, robustness, or actual_data. Historical labels remain readable without rewriting their records.

summary.description: Direct topic account, with actual data origin and study scope. Synthetic example describes the DGP and simulation setup; performance addresses the declared target; computation reports recorded timing/convergence; tuning separates selection from sensitivity; robustness describes changed DGPs. Never invent an unmeasured result.

limitation_markdown.description: The scientific uncertainty or condition that limits this topic, without retelling its primary account. Display-routing or platform availability is not a scientific limitation. Keep distinct missing, failed and unstarted work truthful.

implication_markdown.description: Concise consequence for interpretation, intended use or next work; link the primary topic account instead of repeating its numbers or full explanation. Do not authorize a run or infer a researcher preference.

question_ids.description: Exact effective protocol.claim_tests[].test_id values covered by this decision dimension, including prospectively added_tests. Use the same identifiers as analyst question_results and lead question_reviews; do not invent aliases.

exhibit_ids.description: Exact same-evaluation table/figure IDs supporting this topic, selected from existing analyst exhibits. New authored accounts name relevant exhibits here; empty when no observed exhibit applies. Optional for retained accounts. This routes complete exhibits without changing their values, scope or interpretation.

headline_exhibit_ids.description: Verified table/figure exhibits from this evaluation that support the overall result, in preferred order within Experiments and Results. Empty when no observed numerical result is available. Summary contains no exhibits. Detailed answers link to an exhibit's home in Experiments and Results.

method_recap_markdown.description: Authored visible short recap: exact implemented target, defining mechanism, returned output and decisive condition. Follow the supplied scientific-explanation reference and interpret essential symbols locally. Cite the frozen method/implementation sources. Keep the full formulation in method_formulation_markdown; do not extract the recap heuristically or create new mathematics.

notation_markdown.description: Historical Markdown lookup. Under project_notation_v1 omit this field and adopt additions through notation_updates; the harness generates the exact account lookup. For retained catalogs without that capability, use only recurring mathematical symbols already used in the scientific account: symbol, definition, scientific meaning and relevant units. Exclude ordinary metric names, abbreviations, software terms and computational cost; explain measures in full beside the results and do not invent symbols merely to populate this table. Keep essential meanings visible at first use. Preserve distinctions between target risk, implemented bound, numerical reference error and repeated-experiment uncertainty where applicable. No historical glossary is inferred.

question_reviews.description: Exactly one review for each effective protocol.claim_tests[].test_id, including prospectively added_tests. Preserve the analyst's exact question identifiers; do not merge tests or replace them with aliases.

question_id.description: The exact effective protocol.claim_tests[].test_id reviewed here, matching the analyst result's question_id. This is the existing protocol identifier, not a new question alias.

review_markdown.description: Assess the analyst answer against evidence available in this evaluation, retaining uncertainty and limitations and attributing disagreements. State the assessment, support and consequence without repeating every table or implying independent review of another version.

theorist_findings_markdown.description: Applicable independent Theorist qualification or disagreement and its consequence for this exact test, with attribution and source. A short concurrence is sufficient when the audit adds no qualification. Do not copy the primary answer or imply review of later Lead bytes.

next_steps_markdown.description: The next useful question and resolving work for this finding; reference the responsible phase and existing issue when applicable.

conclusion.description: State the decisive supported observation and its boundary for the researcher goal, including applicable uncertainty and tested scope. Follow the supplied summary and claims-and-evidence references. Successful execution is not a favorable scientific outcome; missing comparisons, failed attempts and synthetic-only support remain explicit.
